Howl<WH03213><WTH8685>, ye ships<WH0591> of Tarshish<WH08659>; for it is laid waste<WH07703><WTH8795>, so that there is no house<WH01004>, no entering in<WH0935><WTH8800>: from the land<WH0776> of Chittim<WH03794> it is revealed<WH01540><WTH8738> to them.

Be still<WH01826><WTH8798>, ye inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> of the isle<WH0339>; thou whom the merchants<WH05503><WTH8802> of Zidon<WH06721>, that pass over<WH05674><WTH8802> the sea<WH03220>, have replenished<WH04390><WTH8765>. <RF>still: Heb. silent<Rf>
And by great<WH07227> waters<WH04325> the seed<WH02233> of Sihor<WH07883>, the harvest<WH07105> of the river<WH02975>, <FI>is<Fi> her revenue<WH08393>; and she is a mart<WH05505> of nations<WH01471>.

Be thou ashamed<WH0954><WTH8798>, O Zidon<WH06721>: for the sea<WH03220> hath spoken<WH0559><WTH8804>, <FI>even<Fi> the strength<WH04581> of the sea<WH03220>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, I travail<WH02342><WTH8804> not, nor bring forth children<WH03205><WTH8804>, neither do I nourish up<WH01431><WTH8765> young men<WH0970>, <FI>nor<Fi> bring up<WH07311><WTH8790> virgins<WH01330>.
As at the report<WH08088> concerning Egypt<WH04714>, <FI>so<Fi> shall they be sorely pained<WH02342><WTH8799> at the report<WH08088> of Tyre<WH06865>.
Pass ye over<WH05674><WTH8798> to Tarshish<WH08659>; howl<WH03213><WTH8685>, ye inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> of the isle<WH0339>.

<FI> Is<Fi> this your joyous<WH05947> <FI>city<Fi> , whose antiquity<WH06927> <FI>is<Fi> of ancient<WH06924> days<WH03117>? her own feet<WH07272> shall carry<WH02986><WTH8686> her afar off<WH07350> to sojourn<WH01481><WTH8800>. <RF>afar...: Heb. from afar off<Rf>

Who hath taken this counsel<WH03289><WTH8804> against Tyre<WH06865>, the crowning<WH05849><WTH8688> <FI>city<Fi> , whose merchants<WH05503><WTH8802> <FI>are<Fi> princes<WH08269>, whose traffickers<WH03667> <FI>are<Fi> the honourable<WH03513><WTH8737> of the earth<WH0776>?

The LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635> hath purposed<WH03289><WTH8804> it, to stain<WH02490><WTH8763> the pride<WH01347> of all glory<WH06643>, <FI>and<Fi> to bring into contempt<WH07043><WTH8687> all the honourable<WH03513><WTH8737> of the earth<WH0776>. <RF>to stain: Heb. to pollute<Rf>
Pass<WH05674><WTH8798> through thy land<WH0776> as a river<WH02975>, O daughter<WH01323> of Tarshish<WH08659>: <FI>there is<Fi> no more strength<WH04206>. <RF>strength: Heb. girdle<Rf>

He stretched out<WH05186><WTH8804> his hand<WH03027> over the sea<WH03220>, he shook<WH07264><WTH8689> the kingdoms<WH04467>: the LORD<WH03068> hath given a commandment<WH06680><WTH8765> against the merchant<WH03667> <FI>city<Fi> , to destroy<WH08045><WTH8687> the strong<WH04581> holds<WH04581> thereof. <RF>against...: or, concerning a merchantman<Rf> <RF>the merchant city: Heb. Canaan<Rf> <RF>strong...: or, strengths<Rf>

And he said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Thou shalt no more<WH03254><WTH8686> rejoice<WH05937><WTH8800>, O thou oppressed<WH06231><WTH8794> virgin<WH01330>, daughter<WH01323> of Zidon<WH06721>: arise<WH06965><WTH8798>, pass over<WH05674><WTH8798> to Chittim<WH03794>; there also shalt thou have no rest<WH05117><WTH8799>.

Behold the land<WH0776> of the Chaldeans<WH03778>; this people<WH05971> was not, <FI>till<Fi> the Assyrian<WH0804> founded<WH03245><WTH8804> it for them that dwell in the wilderness<WH06728>: they set up<WH06965><WTH8689> the towers<WH0971> thereof, they raised up<WH06209><WTH8782> the palaces<WH0759> thereof; <FI>and<Fi> he brought<WH07760><WTH8804> it to ruin<WH04654>.
Howl<WH03213><WTH8685>, ye ships<WH0591> of Tarshish<WH08659>: for your strength<WH04581> is laid waste<WH07703><WTH8795>.<CM>

And it shall come to pass in that day<WH03117>, that Tyre<WH06865> shall be forgotten<WH07911><WTH8737> seventy<WH07657> years<WH08141>, according to the days<WH03117> of one<WH0259> king<WH04428>: after the end<WH07093> of seventy<WH07657> years<WH08141> shall Tyre<WH06865> sing<WH07892> as an harlot<WH02181><WTH8802>. <RF>shall Tyre...: Heb. it shall be unto Tyre as the song of an harlot<Rf>

Take<WH03947><WTH8798> an harp<WH03658>, go about<WH05437><WTH8798> the city<WH05892>, thou harlot<WH02181><WTH8802> that hast been forgotten<WH07911><WTH8737>; make sweet<WH03190><WTH8685> melody<WH05059><WTH8763>, sing many<WH07235><WTH8685> songs<WH07892>, that thou mayest be remembered<WH02142><WTH8735>.

And it shall come to pass after the end<WH07093> of seventy<WH07657> years<WH08141>, that the LORD<WH03068> will visit<WH06485><WTH8799> Tyre<WH06865>, and she shall turn<WH07725><WTH8804> to her hire<WH0868>, and shall commit fornication<WH02181><WTH8804> with all the kingdoms<WH04467> of the world<WH0776> upon the face<WH06440> of the earth<WH0127>.

And her merchandise<WH05504> and her hire<WH0868> shall be holiness<WH06944> to the LORD<WH03068>: it shall not be treasured<WH0686><WTH8735> nor laid up<WH02630><WTH8735>; for her merchandise<WH05504> shall be for them that dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068>, to eat<WH0398><WTH8800> sufficiently<WH07654>, and for durable<WH06266> clothing<WH04374>. <RF>durable: Heb. old<Rf><CM>
